description: Junru Lu is a Foundation Model Researcher at Tencent YouTu Lab, working on foundation models, efficient attention, and memory for long-horizon agents.

articles.summary: 记忆结构、检索策略与主动上下文管理的技术演进。

featured.name: Youtu-LLM
featured.summary_zh: 从零预训练的轻量语言模型，以常识、STEM与智能体任务组成训练课程，培养原生推理与规划能力。
featured.summary: A lightweight language model pre-trained from scratch, with a Commonsense–STEM–Agent curriculum and native reasoning and planning capabilities.

featured.name: SSA
featured.summary_zh: 在训练中双向对齐全注意力与稀疏注意力的输出，缩小两种注意力模式之间的差距。
featured.summary: Bidirectional alignment of full and sparse attention outputs during training, addressing the mismatch between the two attention modes.

featured.name: ContextPilot
featured.summary_zh: 面向长程智能体的主动上下文管理，结合规划、长期记忆、软卸载与动作级强化学习信用分配。
featured.summary: Proactive context management for long-horizon agents, with planning, memory, soft offloading, and action-level credit assignment.

news.label: MAY 2026
news.html_zh: 我们发布了《Toward Native Multimodal Modeling: A Roadmap》，梳理原生多模态架构、训练、数据、部署与评测。
news.html: We released Toward Native Multimodal Modeling: A Roadmap, covering architectures, training, data, deployment, and evaluation.

news.label: JAN 2026
news.html_zh: Youtu-VL 将视觉与语言词元纳入统一的自回归监督。
news.html: Youtu-VL introduces unified autoregressive supervision for visual and language tokens.

news.label: DEC 2025

news.html: We released Youtu-LLM, a lightweight language model pre-trained from scratch.
